title: Privacy-aware Data Discovery
description: Develop visual analytic workflows for discovering useful open data while identifying disclosure risks.
overview: Open datasets can become privacy risks when seemingly harmless releases are joined with other data. This research develops human-centered visual analytics that help data defenders inspect vulnerable joins, calibrate disclosure risk, and evaluate whether joined datasets provide enough utility to justify their use.
imageAlt: PRIVEE visualization for evaluating disclosure risk in joined datasets

publications.summary: VALUE introduces a utility metric and visual analytic workflow for finding joinable datasets, prioritizing them by usefulness, and refining that evaluation through human judgment.
publications.imageAlt: VALUE interface for inspecting the utility of joining open datasets
publications.caption: Inspecting the utility of joined open datasets through VALUE.

publications.summary: A red-team exercise identifies vulnerabilities in the release-and-forget model of open data and motivates proactive monitoring strategies that let data defenders recalibrate privacy risk as new datasets appear.
publications.imageAlt: Examples of open-data disclosure risks identified through red teaming
publications.caption: Disclosure risks that emerge as new open datasets become available.

publications.summary: PRIVEE is a visual risk-inspection workflow that helps data defenders explore vulnerable joins and interpret disclosure risk at multiple levels of data granularity.
publications.imageAlt: Workflow showing how data defenders use PRIVEE to inspect privacy risk
publications.caption: The data-defender workflow and role of interactive visualization in PRIVEE.

publications.summary: This state-of-the-art report surveys methods for privacy-preserving visualization and identifies research opportunities across privacy-utility tradeoffs, attack scenarios, stakeholder needs, and interactive access controls.
publications.imageAlt: Research landscape for privacy-preserving data visualization
publications.caption: The research landscape for privacy-preserving data visualization.
